purpose.zh: 练臀部和腿后侧，提升骨盆稳定
purpose.en: Build the glutes and hamstrings and steady your pelvis.

text.zh: 保持臀桥，骨盆水平，一只脚轻轻抬起
text.en: Hold the bridge with your pelvis level and lift one foot slightly
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.

text.zh: 脚轻放回地，再换另一只脚
text.en: Set the foot down softly, then switch feet.

commonErrors.en: Letting the pelvis drop to one side as the foot lifts.
Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
